record.paper_title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Determine whether there is an interesting Euler-type property of a connected signed graph that characterizes or explains decomposition into negative circles or decomposition into positive circles.

evidence.quote: D3. Is there an interesting Euler-type property of a connected signed graph related to either D1 or D2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed graph is a pair $\Sigma=(G,\sigma)$ where $G=(V,E)$ is a finite undirected graph (loops and multiple edges allowed) and $\sigma:E\to\{+1,-1\}$ is a sign function. The sign of a circle (i.e., a simple closed walk regarded as an edge subset) $C\subseteq E$ is $\sigma(C)=\prod_{e\in C}\sigma(e)$; the circle is positive if $\sigma(C)=+1$ and negative if $\sigma(C)=-1$. A negative-circle decomposition of $\Sigma$ is a partition of $E$ into edge sets of negative circles; a positive-circle decomposition is defined analogously.

Recall that an unsigned connected graph admits a decomposition of its edge set into circles if and only if every vertex has even degree (Euler's theorem). The problem is the following:

Identify and prove an "Euler-type" structural property of a connected signed graph $\Sigma$ — that is, a local or degree-based combinatorial condition on vertices (and possibly on signs of incident edges) — that characterizes, or otherwise meaningfully explains, when $\Sigma$ admits a decomposition of its edge set into negative circles, and similarly when it admits a decomposition into positive circles.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in Zaslavsky's problem collection on negative circles in signed graphs, published in AKCE Int. J. Graphs Combin. (2018). It is posed as an open exploratory question, and no subsequent work found in the search establishes a definitive Euler-type characterization of negative- or positive-circle decompositions for connected signed graphs.

status_evidence.title: Negative (and positive) circles in signed graphs: A problem collection
status_evidence.snippet: Problem collection on negative and positive circles in signed graphs, including questions on circle decompositions.
status_evidence.claim: The Euler-type property question for signed-graph circle decompositions is posed as an open problem in this collection.

status_evidence.title: Negative (and positive) circles in signed graphs - lecture notes
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses decomposition into negative circles and bounds in terms of l(Σ) and d(|Σ|), without giving an Euler-type characterization.
status_evidence.claim: No Euler-type characterization for negative/positive circle decomposition is provided; the question remains exploratory.
